messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV: P1 - Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed on /v1/generate in prod (region: us-west-2). 5xx rate elevated from 0.4% -> 7.9% in last 5m. Latency p95 jumped from 420ms -> 2.6s. Alert sources: gateway, scheduler, model-runtime. Symptoms mention batching queue growth (scheduler.batch_queue_length). Link: https://internal/alerts/3410012345

alex: acked. i'm oncall. paging now. first step: confirm customer impact and whether this is new deploy. who pushed in last hour?

julia: no deploys in last 60m from ci. gateway-bot shows steady config.

maya: looking at runtime metrics — scheduler batch queue length spiked ~00:04 UTC to ~180k. head-of-line blocking visible for model alias "rwd-7b-prod". KV cache growth is high; memory pressure on a subset of runtime pods.

ravi: autoscaler didn't spin up more instances; dedicated GPU pool appears saturated (utilization ~98%). scaling policy hit cap.

alex: ok, sounds like batching/scheduler saturation causing timeouts/5xx. impact: several customers reporting errors. @customer-success can you paste affected tenant IDs?

customer-success: customer-reports: tenant-1872 (chat), tenant-3303 (search), a handful of internal smoke tests. No external LOS escalations yet but elevated error counts for these tenants in the last 10m.

alex: triage plan:
1) reduce batching to drain queue (short term)
2) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for new requests
3) if needed, throttle ingress QPS at gateway to protect runtime
4) post-incident: tune autoscaler caps and batch sizing

maya: agree. i'll flip batching window down and disable prefix batching for rwd-7b-prod. executing config change now. command:
```
# internal config update (admin-api)
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/configs/update -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"model_alias":"rwd-7b-prod","batching":{"enabled":false,"max_batch_size":1}}'
```

eng-oncall: please coordinate — disabling batching will increase per-request compute but should stop hol blocking. expect higher token cost.

gateway-bot: applying edge rule to route new traffic to fallback variant rwd-7b-prod-fallback (half capacity) for 5m canary. rollout id: ro-3410012345.

alex: executing gateway throttle to limit new ingress to 60% of normal QPS to reduce load while queue drains. command:
```
# throttle at gateway
POST https://gateway.internal/rate_limit -d '{"path":"/v1/generate","factor":0.6}'
```

maya: starting eviction job against oldest batches to clear head-of-line. using runtime admin:
```
# runtime admin
kubectl exec -n runtime runtime-admin-0 -- /bin/sh -c "python3 tools/evict_batches.py --model rwd-7b-prod --age-threshold 30"
```

ravi: autoscaler policy temporarily bumped to +2 nodes (manual override) in gpu-pool-3 to buy headroom. provisioning in progress.

alex: monitoring graphs. gate 5xx count still high but trending down. p95 latency from 2.6s -> 1.4s after batching toggle and gateway throttle. queue size: 180k -> 60k now.

maya: note — we saw a backlog root cause where one runtime shard's batcher got stuck on a long-running request (client-side injections with huge seq-len). that blocked the scheduler backlog due to HOL ordering. we're adding a per-request max-batch-wait and a hard-kv-cache-size limit as follow-up.

julia: seeing runtimes with OOM events on a couple pods before we evicted. logs:
```
runtime-42 | ERROR OOM when allocating 2.8GB for kv cache
runtime-42 | WARN dropping oldest kv entries
```

customer-success: update from tenants: tenant-1872 reports intermittent 502s but recovery noticed. keep them posted.

alex: will open a limited status page entry: "We are investigating elevated errors on /v1/generate. Mitigation in progress." cc: @customer-success to post to impacted customers.

customer-success: posted targeted message to tenant-1872 and tenant-3303 with note about mitigation steps and ETA 30m.

gateway-bot: rollout ro-3410012345 to fallback completed, routing ~35% of new requests to fallback model variant. No errors observed on fallback so far.

maya: autoscaler nodes came up; added capacity further reduced queue. clearing backlog to <5k. runtime errors down to baseline.

alex: metrics update (5m after mitigations): 5xx rate now 0.8% (near baseline), p95 latency 520ms. continuing to monitor for 30m. keeping batching disabled for now and routing to fallback.

julia: started capture of flamegraphs+allocs for runtimes that saw OOM to identify kv-cache mis-sizing. saving artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/3410012345/

eng-oncall: noting customer-impact window: start 2026-03-15T00:04:05Z, partial mitigation applied 2026-03-15T00:20:30Z, resolved (errors returned to baseline) 2026-03-15T00:45:00Z. will open postmortem and action items.

maya: immediate action items: increase per-shard eviction aggressiveness, add timeout for single-request batch hold (30s -> 5s), add per-request length guard, and review autoscaler max caps.

ravi: infra action: update scaling policy for gpu-pool-3 to allow temporary burst +20% under emergency for 15m. also create alert to detect sustained batch queue > 50k.

alex: thanks team. closing live mitigation. will file postmortem. any last notes?

julia: add test to CI that simulates long-seq requests to ensure they don't block a shard.

customer-success: will follow up with affected tenants with root-cause once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. severity downgraded to P2. incident-thread archived pending postmortem.
